You have to learn actively and quickly, and avoid making too many mistakes. 【5】Finally, the low payment for a new graduate and various living expenses make it difficult to make ends meet, so you may find yourself always on a tight budget.

【6】As the old proverb goes, "Well begun is half done." 【7】If you can handle these challenges successfully after graduation, you will clear the path for future career development, such as job promotion or starting your own business. 【8】So hold on and never give up!
